name: liquibase
description: Database schema change management and version control tool

liquibase.description: Database migration and schema versioning tool
liquibase.usage:
liquibase update
liquibase --changeLogFile=changelog.xml update
liquibase --changeLogFile=changelog.xml rollback --count=1
liquibase --changeLogFile=changelog.xml generateChangeLog
liquibase --changeLogFile=changelog.xml status
